items.text:
i get why this game has mixed reviews. there is some truly honest to god awful ♥♥♥♥ in it. the developer quips need to just be removed (this isn't a marvel movie, i'm trying to take your serious setting seriously lol), the UI/UX/item management needs drastic improvement, docking and undocking takes way more clicks that it should, insane lack of verisimilitude for a 1.0 release (two bags the entirety of the game. you expect me to believe this literally solar system spanning society is reliant on TWO types of bags and theyre not even actual backpacks?) the tutorial ends abruptly after touching on just the basics. that last point is the most devastating, just like Kitfoxs other game Neo-Scavenger, most players are going to (reasonably) get caught up in the minutiae without ever getting to the "game proper" which is everything outside of the first area.

the learning curve is steep and barely visible without context, but its there. each major location across the solar system is designed to teach the player something. k-leg, the first major area the player spends time in includes the aforementioned tutorial, but it doesn't explain ANYTHING about shipbuilding which is arguably what the entire area is supposed to be teaching you since you literally won't be able to get anywhere (not even to the outer reaches of the k-leg boneyard) without at least modifying your starter ship. that is the most egregious thing about this game. because if you can get past k-leg, then you really get to the bulk of the game.

inner system travel teaches you how to use a torch drive both manually and with plots. venus introduces an entirely new atmospheric ship building system and ship racing. ceres makes you forget everything you've learned and build entirely for ship combat or mining. all of these areas are fun and even the story is kind of engaging... but it's all hidden behind a starting area that doesn't teach you the mechanic it requires you to master in order to "beat" it.  that being said, if you put in the time and learn all these systems, it's great. nothing like coursing through the void beating your meat. no seriously, beat your meat while in deep space and see what happens.
items.text_zh:
我明白为什么这款游戏评价褒贬不一了。里面确实有一些真他妈糟糕的玩意儿。开发者的俏皮话就该直接删掉（这又不是漫威电影，我可是在认真对待你那严肃的设定啊哈哈），UI/UX/物品管理需要大幅改进，对接和脱离对接需要的点击次数远超应有，对于一个1.0正式版来说，拟真度低得离谱（整个游戏就两种包。你指望我相信这个横跨整个太阳系的社会就靠两种包，而且它们甚至都不是真正的背包？）教程在只讲了最基础的东西之后就戛然而止。最后一点是最要命的，就像Kitfox的另一款游戏Neo-Scavenger一样，大多数玩家会（合理地）陷入细枝末节中，永远到不了“真正的游戏”部分，也就是第一个区域之外的一切。

学习曲线很陡峭，没有背景的话几乎看不出来，但它确实存在。太阳系中的每个主要地点都旨在教会玩家一些东西。k-leg，玩家花时间待的第一个主要区域，包含了前面提到的教程，但它完全没有解释任何关于造船的内容，而按理说这整个区域本该教你的就是这个，因为如果不至少改装你的初始飞船，你 literally 哪儿都去不了（连k-leg废船场的边缘都到不了）。这是这款游戏最离谱的地方。因为如果你能熬过k-leg，那你才真正接触到游戏的主体。

内太阳系旅行教你如何手动和使用航线来操作火炬驱动器。金星引入了一套全新的大气层内造船系统和飞船竞速。谷神星让你忘掉学过的一切，完全围绕飞船战斗或采矿来建造。所有这些区域都很有趣，甚至剧情也算引人入胜……但这一切都藏在一个起始区域后面，而这个区域并不教你它要求你掌握才能“通关”的机制。话虽如此，如果你投入时间学会所有这些系统，那就很棒。没有什么比在虚空中穿行打飞机更爽的了。不，说真的，在深空里打飞机看看会发生什么。
